Walmart’s First Wave of 2026 Black Friday Deals Launches Early on November 12

28 Oct 2026, 08:28 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Gaming Desk · Source: www.ign.com

What Walmart announced

Walmart confirmed that its initial round of Black Friday‑season discounts will go live at 12 a.m. ET on November 12, 2026. The retailer described the sale as a “first major wave” of offers that will span a variety of major brands. As in previous years, Walmart+ members will receive early access to the deals before they become available to the general public.

Early‑access advantage for Walmart+ members

The early‑access window is intended to give Walmart+ subscribers a chance to purchase high‑demand items before they sell out. In past holiday cycles, Walmart’s early sales have featured restocks of hard‑to‑find Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG) products and discounts on gaming accessories. While the exact inventory for the November 12 launch has not been detailed, the pattern suggests that members could see similar categories on sale.

How the timing fits into the broader holiday calendar

Black Friday itself falls on November 27, 2026, but retailers increasingly spread promotions across multiple dates. Walmart’s early‑November launch follows a trend where shoppers can secure discounts well before the traditional Black Friday weekend.

For comparison, Best Buy announced its own schedule: a "Door BOOsters" promotion from October 30 to November 1 and an early Black Friday sale beginning November 6. Both retailers are therefore offering shoppers several opportunities to find deals ahead of the main event.

Sample items that could appear in the sale

The announcement included a list of products that have appeared in recent Walmart gaming promotions and may be part of the upcoming wave. The list is not a confirmed inventory, but it illustrates the types of merchandise typically featured:

  • 007 First Light Standard Edition for PlayStation 5
  • PlayStation Pulse Explore Wireless Earbuds (Midnight Black)
  • CVLIFE 3.26" VG10 Damascus Folding Pocket Knife
  • 65" Sony BRAVIA 6 OLED 4K HDR Smart Google TV
  • STAR WARS: Galactic Racer – PC (Steam code)
  • Several Magic: The Gathering booster boxes (Marvel Super Heroes, Lorwyn Eclipsed, Star Trek, The Hobbit)
  • Wolfbox 4000A Cordless Car Jump Starter with a 24,000 mAh power bank
  • Gamesir G7 Pro Wireless Gaming Controller

These examples span consoles, accessories, home‑entertainment hardware, and collectible card games, reflecting Walmart’s historically broad approach to gaming‑related discounts.

Practical implications for shoppers

  • Plan for early access – If you are a Walmart+ member, set a reminder for the midnight launch. Early access can be crucial for limited‑stock items such as collectible cards or high‑demand consoles.
  • Monitor inventory – Walmart’s website often updates product availability in real time. Refreshing the page or using the retailer’s app can help you snag items before they sell out.
  • Compare with competing sales – Best Buy’s early‑November promotions may overlap with similar product categories. Checking both sites can ensure you capture the best price.
  • Budget for later deals – Industry analysts note that many of the deepest discounts on gaming hardware and high‑end TVs tend to appear later in the Black Friday window (often mid‑ to late‑November). Shoppers who can wait may find better pricing after the initial wave.

What remains uncertain

  • Exact product lineup – Walmart has not released a definitive list of discounted items for the November 12 wave. The items mentioned in the announcement are illustrative rather than exhaustive.
  • Depth of discounts – Percentage reductions or price points have not been disclosed. Historical data shows a wide range, from modest markdowns to steep clearance on older models.
  • Availability of non‑member deals – While Walmart+ members receive early access, the timing and selection of deals for non‑members after the early window are still unknown.
  • Impact of supply chain constraints – Ongoing global chip shortages could affect stock levels for electronics, potentially limiting the quantity of discounted units.

How to verify the announcement

The details above are drawn from Walmart’s official press release as reported by IGN. Readers can verify the information by visiting the source article: [Walmart Announces First Wave of 2026 Black Friday Deals, Starting November 12](https://www.ign.com/articles/walmart-announces-first-wave-of-2026-black-friday-deals-starting-november-12)

For the most up‑to‑date listings, check Walmart’s Black Friday landing page on the day of the launch and monitor the retailer’s social‑media channels for real‑time announcements.
